Journey_Title: Trade-in / Appraisal Management Reporting (Telemetry + Reports + Dashboards + Agentforce + Audit)
Pre_Requisites: Auto_Appraisal_Config_UJ + Auto_Appraisal_Data_UJ + Auto_Appraisal_Integration_UJ completed; Telemetry pipeline live; CRM Analytics (Analytics for Automotive) licensed if dashboards are in scope; Agentforce for Automotive licensed if agent surfaces are in scope.
Business_Process: Telemetry counters → Audit Trail → Native Reports → CRM Analytics dashboards (optional) → Agentforce for Automotive surfaces (optional) → Field Service Inventory rollup (256) → Forecasting & Pipeline (Opportunity-linked Appraisals)
Detailed_Scenarios:
Scenario Overview: After the Appraisal TUJ runs at least once in the org, every observability surface that must light up is enumerated. This is the post-go-live readiness contract.

Step-by-Step:
1. [Telemetry Owner] Telemetry counters (Epic Telemetry section — must all increment as the TUJ runs):
   - Number of Appraisal records created in an Org
   - Number of Appraisal Item records created in an Org
   - Number of Appraisal Adjustment Records
   - Number of Appraisal Valuations created
   - OmniStudio: Omni script usage (vehicle Appraisal flow)
   - OmniStudio: FlexCard usage (Appraisal + Appraisal Item)
   - Number of times the Appraisal flow was initiated
   - Number of times the Appraisal Item flow was initiated
   - Number of orgs where the Appraisal Pref has been turned on
   - Number of edits made to Appraisal / Appraisal Item / Appraisal Adjustment
   - Number of Appraisals associated with Leads / Opportunities / Accounts / Cases
   Logged field set per record type matches Epic Telemetry mapping (no PII).
2. [Audit Owner] Audit Trail expectations:
   - Every Appraisal Status transition appears in Setup Audit Trail (when picklist is changed via flow / approval).
   - Approval Process steps log Submitter / Approver / Comments per standard.
   - Final Appraisal Price Field Update on approval logged.
3. [Reports Owner] Native Reports (P0 — must ship as standard report folder 'Appraisal Management'):
   - Appraisals by Status (Draft / In Valuation / Pending Approval / Approved / Rejected / Inspection Scheduled / Final).
   - Appraisals by Interest Type (Valuation / Sales / Trade-in).
   - Appraisals by Source — Lead / Opportunity / Account / Asset.
   - Appraisals by Dealer Sales Executive (created by) — productivity report.
   - Average Adjustment Value by Adjustment Type (Markup / Discount / Reconditioning / Dents).
   - Approval cycle time (Submitted → Approved): Created Date → Modified Date when Status = Approved.
   - Appraisals with valuation responses count (multi-provider visibility) — Appraisal Item Provider Valuation rollup.
   - 256 only: Inspection Visits per Appraisal (when GV framework whitelisting deployed).
4. [Dashboards Owner] CRM Analytics dashboards (Analytics for Automotive — P1):
   - Add an 'Appraisal Performance' tab to the existing Dealer Performance dashboard.
     - KPIs: total appraisals, approval rate, average final appraisal price, average customer asking vs final delta.
     - Slicers: Dealer, Make, Model, Year, Adjustment Type, Provider.
   - 256: feed Appraisal data into Inventory Performance dashboard (because Approved Appraisal → Vehicle Inventory record).
   - Dataflow refresh order: Vehicle → Asset → Appraisal → Appraisal Item → Appraisal Item Provider Valuation → Appraisal Adjustment.
5. [Agentforce Owner] Agentforce for Automotive (optional, P2):
   - Topic: 'Trade-in Appraisal Management'.
   - Actions:
     - 'Look up appraisal by VIN' (Apex action wrapping Appraisal SOQL).
     - 'Summarize appraisal' (Einstein Summary on Appraisal record — Customer Asking Price, Initial / Adjusted / Final Appraisal Price, Adjustment list, Provider Valuations).
     - 'Re-route approval' (Flow action that re-submits Appraisal for approval to a different approver).
   - Einstein Studio prompt template: 'Appraisal Negotiation Helper' that consumes Appraisal Item Provider Valuation rows and the customer asking price to suggest negotiation talking points.
6. [TUA / Tableau Owner] Tableau Unified Analytics (TUA — optional, P3): not in scope per Epic. Listed for completeness; mark N/A unless dealership has TUA licensed.
7. [Forecasting Owner] Advanced Account Forecasting:
   - When Appraisal is linked to an Opportunity Line Item (Epic 14, R256), forecasted opportunity amount can include the Final Appraisal Price as a credit toward sale price. Forecast cadence: weekly. Persona: Sales Manager.
8. [Field Service Owner] Field Service Inventory rollup (256, when Epic 13 ships):
   - Approved Appraisal with Handover Completed → Vehicle Inventory record visible in Inventory dashboard within next dataflow refresh window.
9. [Compliance Owner] Compliant Data Sharing / fair-lending checks: not applicable to Appraisal directly (no lending fields), but Appraisal record is referenced by Financial Account in the cross-feature TUJ — confirm Compliant Data Sharing stages on Financial Account read Appraisal.Final_Appraisal_Price as a contributing input.
10. [Validation] Run /auto:audit and confirm 0 errors against the Reporting checklist.
Features_Mapped: Telemetry pipeline, Audit Trail, Reports & Dashboards builder, CRM Analytics (Analytics for Automotive), Agentforce for Automotive (Topics, Actions, Einstein Summary, Einstein Studio prompts), Advanced Account Forecasting, Field Service Inventory dashboards, Compliant Data Sharing
Personas: Telemetry Owner; Reports Owner; Dashboards Owner (CRM Analytics); Agentforce Owner; Sales Manager (forecast consumer); Compliance Owner
Complexity:
Native Reports only - P0
Native Reports + CRM Analytics tab - P1
Native Reports + CRM Analytics + Agentforce surfaces - P2
Add TUA tab - P3
Frequency: Native Reports & Telemetry: real-time per record action; CRM Analytics: per dataflow refresh (typically nightly); Agentforce: live conversational; Forecasting: weekly
Setup_Required: Auto_Appraisal_Config_UJ + Auto_Appraisal_Data_UJ + Auto_Appraisal_Integration_UJ; at least one Auto_Appraisal_TUJ_001 run so counters and reports have data.
Expected_Outcome: Every observability surface (telemetry counters, audit trail, native reports, CRM Analytics dashboards, optional Agentforce, optional forecasting) lights up after the TUJ runs at least once. Approval cycle time and multi-provider valuation usage are visible to Sales / Finance / OEM stakeholders.
Integration_Points: Telemetry pipeline, Audit Trail, CRM Analytics dataflow / recipe, Agentforce conversational layer + Einstein Studio, Advanced Account Forecasting, Field Service Inventory
Performance_Requirements: Reports render < 5s; CRM Analytics dashboard load < 8s; Agentforce response < 3s p50.
